# v26.0 WP10: Phoenix Empire (BYZ + ROM) bloc trigger & location ownership guard for Romanization movements.
# Note: oe_is_phoenix_empire is defined in oe_theme_empire_triggers.txt and reused here (zero duplicate triggers).
# Generated by gen_v260_cul_rel_overhaul.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. True for the Phoenix Empire (BYZ/ROM) or any direct/indirect subject of BYZ/ROM.
oe_is_phoenix_bloc = {
    OR = {
        oe_is_phoenix_empire = yes
        AND = {
            country_exists = c:ROM
            is_subject_or_below_of = c:ROM
        }
        AND = {
            country_exists = c:BYZ
            is_subject_or_below_of = c:BYZ
        }
    }
}

# Location scope. Live ownership includes all levels of Phoenix Empire (BYZ/ROM) subjects.
# Do not use controller: military occupation alone does not extend Romanization.
oe_rw_identity_spread_location = {
    has_owner = yes
    owner = { oe_is_phoenix_bloc = yes }
}
